record.question: Answer any three of the following: (a) Write down any two conditions subject to which service qualifies. (b) Mention any five classes of pension enumerated in the CCS (pension) Rules, 1972 (You need not give definitions). In case you do no weightage will be given. (c) List out the actions that are required for preparation of list of Government servants due for retirement. (d) What is the condition for retirement on completion of 20 years' qualifying service by a Government servant and who are the exceptions? (e) Write down any two actions that are required to be taken by the Head of Office where he has received an intimation about the death of a Government servant while in service.
